exposure: favipiravir exposure during the second and third trimesters
cohort: Pregnant women beyond 14 weeks gestation who delivered between June 1, 2021, and May 31, 2022, and were infected with COVID-19, divided into favipiravir-exposed (99 patients) and non-exposed (115 patients) groups.
finding: Favipiravir exposure during the second and third trimesters was associated with an increased risk of small for gestational age (SGA) infants.
mod_finding: No significant differences were found in cesarean delivery rates between the favipiravir-exposed and non-exposed groups.
birth_weight: Categorized as small for gestational age (SGA)
gest_age: Participants beyond 14 weeks gestation; outcomes included preterm delivery and small for gestational age.
